title: SET_OPTIONS fails with SET_OPTIONS_INVALID_INFLATION
pattern: A transaction whose SET_OPTIONS operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (invalid_inflation). The inflation destination does not exist. Inflation ended at protocol 12, but the field is still checked at apply.

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
